## `removeAnalyst`

*Available in [R](#removeanalyst-r)*
=== "R"
    !!! bug "Deprecated Function"
        This function has been deprecated, and will be removed in a future CIDAtools release.
    <h4>Description</h4>

    This function removes the default analyst set with set_global_default_analyst()
     from the users ~/cida_defaults.dcf.

    <h4>Usage</h4>
    ```R

    removeAnalyst()

    ```
    <h4>Arguments</h4>
    *No arguments*
    <h4>Returns</h4>

    Message indicating success or failure
